author: Kurt Sanders
releaseNotes:
Version 2.3.1
• REQUIRES HPM v1.9.11 or higher for HPM install or update.
1. Fixed Logging Off (level 0) in Balboa-Hot-Tub-API-Library so Info/Warn/Error logs are properly suppressed when Logging Level is set to Off.
2. Prevented the parent device 'switch' attribute from turning 'on' when Pump 1 is only running on Low during an active filter cycle (while keeping 'Pumps' accurate).
3. Fixed parse() loop exit after disconnect() to prevent duplicate 'Command complete' log entries.
4. (v2.3.0) Added Preset High/Low Temperature preferences (presetTempHigh, presetTempLow) and stateful 'Spa Preset Temp (High/Low)' child switch.
5. (v2.2.1) Fast-close TCP polling (~0.5s), real-time Generic Component Switch sync, getFilterSchedule(), optional autoSyncClock, full °C support, and App UI enhancements.
